purpose: A complete, neutral studio with eight independently composed landscape/portrait views.
principles: Large source regions, restrained chrome and deliberate type hierarchy.
Current-layout controls use the existing show.layoutId binding; this Set has no Show.
Device identity and account connections remain outside the package.
Motion animates only a graphics-only layer; native source ancestry stays static.
qualification: Canonical MCP compilation and both-theme visual checks; real-camera native layout preparation, dock actions and dual-format recording tested locally on Apple Silicon. Synthetic guest/content signals do not qualify network guest audio/video.

controls.layouts: Eight logical views; independently composed landscape and portrait variants
controls.storage: Set Edit saves configured defaults; live cues remain transient. Room bindings and personal dock arrangements remain outside the portable package.
